diagrams/canva_01_print.png: Proposed system architecture connecting environmental measurement, hardware control, communications, operator supervision and high-level computation. Functional links summarize interfaces; detailed control authority is specified in the text.
diagrams/canva_02_print.png: Proposed power architecture with separate motor, servo, logic and sensor branches. Regulation, conductor sizing and protection require measured loads and component specifications.
diagrams/canva_03_print.png: Four-wheel command allocation. A common body-motion request is converted into wheel-angle and speed targets subject to steering travel, actuator limits and proposed feedback.
diagrams/canva_04_print.png: Proposed drive-feedback architecture. Encoder and independently estimated body-motion feedback support tracking and traction monitoring; wheel–ground interaction remains a source of uncertainty.
diagrams/canva_05_print.png: Gas-measurement chain incorporating sensor identification, heater scheduling, raw-response acquisition, reference calibration and validity checks.
diagrams/canva_06_print.png: Particulate-measurement chain incorporating representative airflow, device checks, environmental covariates and reference-based correction.
diagrams/canva_07_print.png: Ultraviolet, pressure and temperature measurement interfaces. BMP180 provides no relative-humidity channel; ultraviolet conversion depends on the identified GUVA board and its calibration.
diagrams/canva_08_print.png: Water-assessment workflow linking probe conditioning, reference checks, stabilization, pH/turbidity acquisition and sample identity.
diagrams/canva_09_print.png: Proposed manipulation workflow. Reach, stability, collision and cable-clearance checks precede motion; joint, current and grip feedback support execution and recovery.
diagrams/canva_10_print.png: Proposed navigation pipeline. Calibrated, synchronized observations support localization and mapping; planning accounts for clearance, braking and steering constraints.
diagrams/canva_11_print.png: Communications and operator-control architecture. Local Wi-Fi supports the dashboard, radio control supplies an alternate command source, and an arbiter rejects stale or conflicting requests.
diagrams/canva_12_print.png: Operating and protective states. Transitions require explicit health, authority and reset conditions; hardware energy interruption remains distinct from a controlled software stop.
diagrams/canva_13_print.png: Mission and data workflow for environmental patrol, industrial inspection, water assessment, lightweight handling and reconnaissance, including quality checks and recovery conditions.
diagrams/canva_14_print.png: Calibration-analysis pipeline separating cleaning, chronological partitioning, training-only preprocessing, validation selection and frozen testing. External-data results require subsequent rover-specific validation.

analysis/ml_outputs/figures/01_dataset_a: External-data coverage and distributions: (a) daily CO means by chronological partition, requiring at least 12 observed hours; (b) separately normalized CO distributions; (c) monthly timestamped and eligible counts; (d) separately normalized RH distributions. Missing periods remain unfilled. Original analysis of Vito (2008), UCI Air Quality, https://doi.org/10.24432/C59K5F, CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/.
analysis/ml_outputs/figures/02_test_metr: Frozen-model MAE, RMSE and R² on 1,102 external-data test observations. Error bars show conditional 95% percentile intervals from 2,000 paired calendar-day bootstrap resamples. The asterisk identifies validation-selected Ridge. Original analysis of Vito (2008), CC BY 4.0.
analysis/ml_outputs/figures/03_selected_: Validation-selected Ridge predictions on external test data: (a) daily reference and predicted CO means, requiring at least 12 observed hours; (b) hourly agreement counts in hexagonal bins and the identity line; (c) prediction-minus-reference residuals, with mean bias −0.157 mg/m³. Scores use hourly observations. Original analysis of Vito (2008), CC BY 4.0.
analysis/ml_outputs/figures/04_residual_: Hourly external-test CO residuals against relative humidity. Markers show means within fixed 10-percentage-point RH bins containing at least 20 observations, positioned at median bin RH; bars show interquartile ranges. Axes use common limits. The associations do not establish humidity causality. Original analysis of Vito (2008), CC BY 4.0.
analysis/ml_outputs/figures/05_desktop_c: External-data model costs and predictor sensitivity: (a) uncompressed pipeline size in MiB; (b) median single-row desktop prediction time and interquartile range over 21 warmed repetitions; (c) validation RMSE increase after predictor permutation, with mean and standard deviation over ten repeats. Desktop costs do not establish embedded feasibility. Original analysis of Vito (2008), CC BY 4.0.
analysis/figures/A07_pH_conditioning.png: Ideal pH-electrode slope and ADC quantization under the declared conditioning assumptions. ADC LSB width is V_ref/2ᴺ; the corresponding pH increment is V_ref/[2ᴺ G S(T)]. Quantization resolution is distinct from calibrated measurement accuracy.
figures/prototype_views.png: Four distinct prototype photographs used for geometric reconstruction. The views constrain component arrangement and show an optional lift configuration; dimensions remain estimated without a scale reference.
blender/M02_mission.png: Blender water-assessment concept with a staged vessel beneath the existing side-mounted pH probe and the chassis on dry support. Autonomous deployment and water-ingress protection require physical validation.
blender/M02_probe_detail.png: Detail of the illustrative sampling interface: the electrode tip enters the liquid while its upper housing remains clear.
blender/M03_mission.png: Blender lightweight-handling concept with a sample vial between the gripper tips and a nearby preparation bench. The principal arm position is preserved; payload and grasp performance remain unmeasured.
blender/M03_gripper_detail.png: Detail of the sample vial and gripper-tip contact arrangement in the preserved arm pose.
blender/M01_mission.png: Blender concept of stationary environmental observation near industrial piping. The scene illustrates component placement and inspection context.
blender/M04_mission.png: Blender visual-reconnaissance concept near debris, with all wheels on a clear support surface. The arrangement is not a rubble-traversal test.
blender/M05_mission.png: Blender patrol concept incorporating proposed deck LiDAR, a humidity pod and a depth camera below the existing mast head. Route markings illustrate mission intent.
